verdict.rationale: Sprinto's own docs list ISO 27001 as a supported framework managed in-platform. They also mention pre-mapped controls, audit-ready reports, in-platform auditor collaboration and audit-partner selection. That shows native framework support, but the depth the story asks for is not shown. Missing for 10: any evidence of the current (2022) Annex A control set, Statement of Applicability generation or management, ISO-specific certification-audit artifacts (e.g., Stage 1/Stage 2 support), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
